frequency_question: What proportion of major federal agency rules complete the full notice-and-comment lifecycle (proposed rule publication to final rule publication) within a 308-day calendar window?
membership_rule: Includes all economically significant rules (impact over $100M) published as a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) that subsequently reached a Final Rule stage. Excludes interim final rules and direct final rules.
coverage_note: 9 named rules representing diverse executive departments; believed roughly representative of controversial high-impact rules.
known_gaps: Sample is biased toward high-profile rules tracked by policy researchers; standard technical rules move faster.
multiplier: 9 cases evaluated; 5 hits within 308 days from NPRM to Final Rule, 4 misses exceeding 308 days due to mandatory statutory comment periods (minimum 60 days) and OIRA review timelines.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and OIRA review statutory constraints remain constant through the current presidential term.
